<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover,user-scalable=no">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#fdeef3">
<title>Hu nyang Mini Game Collection - v4.8.26 RPG Growth & Skills</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#0d0c19;
  --bg2:#151326;
  --panel:#171526;
  --panel2:#201d35;
  --line:#393451;
  --text:#fff8fd;
  --muted:#aaa4bd;
  --pink:#ff70ae;
  --pink2:#ff9bc9;
  --violet:#9a72ff;
  --blue:#70b8ff;
  --yellow:#ffd76b;
  --green:#75e5b5;
  --danger:#ff7488;
  --shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  --r:22px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:#080710;color:var(--text);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif}
body{overflow-x:hidden}
button,input{font:inherit}
button{border:0;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
input{color:inherit}
#app{
  position:relative;
  width:min(100%,430px);
  min-height:100svh;
  margin:0 auto;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% -10%,rgba(255,92,171,.22),transparent 36%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 48%,rgba(134,93,255,.15),transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#141225 0%,#0d0c19 55%,#0a0914 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 70px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
}
#app::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.32;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18px 18px,rgba(255,142,194,.22) 0 2px,transparent 3px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 7px 5px,rgba(167,127,255,.14) 0 1.5px,transparent 2px);
  background-size:72px 72px,53px 53px;
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000,transparent 55%);
}
.page{display:none;position:relative;z-index:1;min-height:100svh;animation:pageIn .22s ease}
.page.active{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
@keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.safeTop{height:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top))}
.screen{padding:10px 16px calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));flex:1}
.noBottom .screen{padding-bottom:24px}
.appbar{height:55px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.appbar h1{font-size:21px;margin:0;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.appbar .subhead{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1px}
.iconBtn{
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:20px;display:grid;place-items:center
}
.logo{
  text-align:center;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.055em;font-size:33px;line-height:1;
  color:#fff;text-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(255,100,176,.45)
}
.logo span{color:#ff83b8}
.logoSmall{font-size:25px;text-align:left}
.logoSub{text-align:center;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#dcb9d0;margin-top:6px}
.paw{color:var(--pink)}
.card{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(29,27,48,.97),rgba(18,17,32,.98));
  border:1px solid rgba(170,148,210,.25);
  border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.primary{
  min-height:55px;border-radius:18px;width:100%;font-weight:950;font-size:17px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff83bc,#ff559e);
  border:1px solid #ffc0dc;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,100,170,.16),0 10px 28px rgba(255,65,143,.24),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.45)
}
.primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.secondary{
  min-height:48px;border-radius:16px;background:#1a182b;border:1px solid var(--line);
  color:#eee9fa;font-weight:850
}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.hidden{display:none!important}

/* splash */
#splashPage{background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,rgba(255,125,188,.28),transparent 36%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 35% 70%,rgba(124,92,255,.18),transparent 34%),
  linear-gradient(180deg,#151326,#0c0b17)}
.splashContent{display:flex;flex:1;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px 24px 28px}
.splashMascot{
  width:min(90%,355px);height:430px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  position:relative;margin-top:-10px
}
.splashMascot::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffb7d7 0%,rgba(255,108,176,.22) 45%,transparent 72%);
  filter:blur(7px)
}
.splashMascot img{
  position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.32));border-radius:28px;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16),0 0 36px rgba(255,105,177,.18)
}
.splashTitle{font-size:47px;margin-top:-24px;transform:rotate(-2deg)}
.splashTitle span{-webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
.splashMini{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#ead8e5;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-top:8px}
.splashStart{margin-top:28px}

/* bottom nav */
.bottomNav{
  position:absolute;z-index:20;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;
  height:calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));padding:7px 24px env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
  background:rgba(18,16,31,.96);border-top:1px solid rgba(174,151,211,.18);
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;backdrop-filter:blur(18px)
}
.bottomNav button{width:86px;background:transparent;color:#8f899f;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.bottomNav b{display:block;font-size:23px;line-height:27px;font-weight:500}
.bottomNav button.active{color:#ff93bf}

/* home */
.homeHeader{padding:3px 0 13px}
.homeHeader .logo{font-size:32px}
.featured{
  width:100%;display:block;text-align:left;
  min-height:155px;padding:14px 14px 14px 16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  border-color:#ff77b4;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,103,175,.3),0 0 25px rgba(255,76,158,.16)
}
.featured::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:
   radial-gradient(circle at 12% 20%,rgba(255,216,111,.18),transparent 22%),
   radial-gradient(circle at 80% 40%,rgba(255,102,176,.24),transparent 35%),
   linear-gradient(135deg,#43213e,#201d45);
}
.featuredText{position:relative;z-index:2;width:59%;padding-top:6px}
.gameTag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:#ffd9e9;font-size:11px;font-weight:900}
.featured h2{font-size:39px;line-height:.9;margin:14px 0 8px;color:#fff;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-shadow:0 3px 0 #8e3461}
.featured p{font-size:12px;color:#f6d8e8;margin:0;line-height:1.35}
.featuredMascot{
  position:absolute;z-index:2;right:-5px;bottom:-7px;width:47%;height:145px;
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center
}
.featuredMascot img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 26%;border-radius:25px;opacity:.96;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.featuredArrow{position:absolute;z-index:4;right:12px;bottom:12px;width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff17;border:1px solid #ffffff28;display:grid;place-items:center}
.gameList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:13px}
.listCard{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:75px;padding:10px 12px;gap:12px}
.listIcon{
  width:55px;height:55px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:27px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#3b3357,#24213a);border:1px solid #4c4568
}
.listInfo{flex:1}
.listInfo h3{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 4px}
.listInfo p{font-size:11px;margin:0;color:#938da3}
.chev{font-size:24px;color:#8e879e}
.disabledGame{opacity:.55}

/* config */
.sectionTitle{font-size:14px;font-weight:950;margin:16px 0 9px}
.segment{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
.segBtn{
  height:43px;border-radius:12px;background:#1c1a2d;border:1px solid #443d5c;color:#bcb5ca;font-weight:900
}
.segBtn.active{
  color:#3c2232;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffafd0,#ff76b3);border-color:#ffd0e4;
  box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,104,176,.2)
}
.nickList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.nickRow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.catDot{
  width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:18px;
  background:#27223a;border:1px solid #443b5c
}
.nickRow:nth-child(2) .catDot{background:#1d3147}
.nickRow:nth-child(3) .catDot{background:#493a20}
.nickRow:nth-child(4) .catDot{background:#31303b}
.nickRow input{
  flex:1;height:43px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #47405f;background:#141321;padding:0 13px;outline:none
}
.nickRow input:focus{border-color:#ff78b1;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,91,160,.12)}
.nickRow input.errorInput{border-color:#ff657c}
.sizeGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px}
.sizeCard{
  min-height:99px;border-radius:16px;background:#1b192a;border:1px solid #423c58;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:7px
}
.sizeCard.active{border-color:#ff7bb5;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ff7bb5,0 0 18px rgba(255,86,164,.19)}
.miniGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,9px);gap:4px}
.miniGrid i{width:9px;height:9px;background:#aaa4bd;border-radius:2px}
.sizeCard.active .miniGrid i{background:#ff8abd}
.sizeCard b{font-size:15px}.sizeCard small{color:#aaa4bd}
.formError{min-height:20px;color:#ff8a9b;font-size:12px;margin-top:10px;font-weight:750}
.configCTA{margin-top:10px}

/* arrange */
.playerTabs{display:flex;gap:7px;overflow-x:auto;padding:3px 0 12px;scrollbar-width:none}
.playerTabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.playerTab{
  flex:0 0 auto;min-width:83px;height:54px;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:13px;background:#1d1a2c;
  border:1px solid #413a57;color:#aea8ba
}
.playerTab.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd0e1,#ff94bd);color:#3a2230;border-color:#fff0f6}
.playerTab b{display:block;font-size:13px}.playerTab small{font-size:10px}
.boardPanel{padding:10px;border-radius:19px;background:#151321;border:1px solid #403850}
.board{display:grid;gap:5px}
.boardCell{
  aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffe1ed,#f6c6da);
  color:#282030;border:1px solid #fff0f6;font-size:clamp(18px,6vw,25px);font-weight:1000;
  box-shadow:inset 0 -2px rgba(117,66,91,.12)
}
.boardCell.selected{outline:3px solid #ff55a0;transform:scale(.96);background:#ffacd0}
.arrangeHelp{font-size:11px;color:#aba4b8;line-height:1.45;margin:10px 4px}
.dualBtns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:11px}
.randomBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#835ef0,#b653f2);border-color:#c69aff}
.arrangeCTA{margin-top:12px}

/* game */
.gamePageBg{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 17%,rgba(54,111,255,.18),transparent 26%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 34%,rgba(255,79,169,.13),transparent 33%)
}
.drawZone{text-align:center;padding:3px 0 14px}
.orb{
  width:155px;height:155px;border-radius:50%;margin:2px auto 10px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 48% 38%,#294b8a 0%,#101d42 45%,#080a19 72%);
  border:5px solid #70d9ff;box-shadow:0 0 14px #3da5ff,0 0 30px rgba(239,79,255,.38),inset 0 0 25px #050a1b
}
.orb::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-12px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,99,198,.75);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,68,181,.45)}
.drawNum{font-size:70px;font-weight:1000;text-shadow:0 0 18px #57bcff}
.drawReady{font-size:28px}
.countText{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#ddd5e7}
.progress{width:180px;height:5px;background:#242039;border-radius:999px;margin:9px auto 0;overflow:hidden}
.progress i{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#74d4ff,#ff66b5)}
.gameBoards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}
.gameBoards.multi{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.playerBoardCard{padding:8px;border-radius:15px;background:#171525;border:1px solid #423a58}
.playerBoardCard.p1{border-color:#ff6eae}.playerBoardCard.p2{border-color:#6bacff}.playerBoardCard.p3{border-color:#ffd262}.playerBoardCard.p4{border-color:#9e7cff}
.playerBoardHead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px}
.playerBoardHead b{font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:75%}
.bingoCount{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:#ff9ac4}
.gameBoard{display:grid;gap:3px}
.gameCell{
  aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:5px;background:#252235;border:1px solid #48405f;display:grid;place-items:center;
  color:#f0ebf5;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(11px,4vw,17px);position:relative;overflow:hidden
}
.gameCell.marked{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffbfd9,#ff8fbe);color:#3b2430;border-color:#ffd7e8}
.gameCell > span{position:relative;z-index:2}
.gameCell.marked::before{content:"🐾";position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.45em;opacity:.32;z-index:1;transform:translateY(1px);filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.2));}
.historyTitle{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;margin:13px 0 7px}
.historyChips{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:3px;scrollbar-width:none}
.historyChips::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.numChip{
  flex:0 0 29px;height:29px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#211e33;border:1px solid #49415e;color:#c8c1d0;font-size:11px;font-weight:900
}
.numChip.latest{background:#ff75b0;color:#fff;border-color:#ffbdd8}

/* win */
#winPage{
  background:
   radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,rgba(255,123,190,.38),transparent 33%),
   radial-gradient(circle at 25% 60%,rgba(255,200,91,.15),transparent 25%),
   linear-gradient(180deg,#24162d,#100e1d 70%)
}
.winScreen{padding:25px 20px 24px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.winImage{
  width:100%;max-width:370px;min-height:300px;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center
}
.winImage::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:310px;height:250px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#ffb5d5,rgba(255,91,171,.16) 55%,transparent 70%);filter:blur(5px)}
.winImage img{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;max-height:330px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.32));}
.winnerWord{
  font-size:58px;font-weight:1000;line-height:.88;color:#ffe680;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:-5px 0 12px;
  -webkit-text-stroke:2px #c66c26;text-shadow:0 6px 0 #823957,0 0 24px rgba(255,220,87,.28);transform:rotate(-2deg)
}
.winnerName{font-size:24px;font-weight:1000;color:#ffacd0;margin-bottom:7px}
.winMessage{font-size:13px;color:#eee0e9;margin-bottom:22px}
.winBtns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;width:100%}

/* toast */
.toast{
  position:absolute;z-index:50;left:50%;bottom:90px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);
  min-width:210px;max-width:90%;padding:11px 15px;border-radius:14px;background:#2a2439;border:1px solid #554969;
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s
}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%)}

/* desktop preview */
@media(min-width:700px){
  body{padding:24px 0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%,#242036,#090810 62%)}
  #app{min-height:calc(100svh - 48px);height:min(860px,calc(100svh - 48px));border-radius:30px;border:1px solid #332e46}
  .page{min-height:100%}
  .splashContent{min-height:100%}
}

/* mascot idle animation */
@keyframes catIdle{
  0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1deg) scale(1)}
  25%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(.3deg) scale(1.008)}
  50%{transform:translateY(-9px) rotate(1deg) scale(1.016)}
  75%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-.2deg) scale(1.008)}
}
@keyframes catCardSway{
  0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1.2deg)}
  50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(1.2deg)}
}
@keyframes catWin{
  0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1deg) scale(1)}
  20%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(1deg) scale(1.025)}
  42%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-.7deg) scale(.99)}
  68%{transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(.5deg) scale(1.012)}
}
@keyframes catPoke{
  0%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
  35%{transform:translateY(-18px) scale(1.04) rotate(2deg)}
  65%{transform:translateY(2px) scale(.985) rotate(-1deg)}
  100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
}
@keyframes twinkle{
  0%,100%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.8) rotate(0deg)}
  50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.2) rotate(15deg)}
}
.splashMascot img{
  animation:catIdle 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin:50% 85%;
  will-change:transform;
}
.featuredMascot img{
  animation:catCardSway 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin:50% 90%;
  will-change:transform;
}
.winImage img{
  animation:catWin 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin:50% 90%;
  will-change:transform;
}
.splashMascot.poked img{}
.splashMascot::after{
  content:"✦";
  position:absolute;
  z-index:4;
  right:13%;
  top:11%;
  font-size:28px;
  color:#ffe0ef;
  text-shadow:0 0 14px #ff66ad;
  animation:twinkle 1.55s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .splashMascot img,.featuredMascot img,.winImage img,
  .splashMascot::after{animation:none!important}
}


.countNum{display:inline-block;min-width:1ch;text-align:center}
.countNum.pop{animation:bingoCountPop .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1.25)}
@keyframes bingoCountPop{
  0%{transform:scale(1)}
  35%{transform:scale(1.72)}
  70%{transform:scale(.9)}
  100%{transform:scale(1)}
}


.comingCard{justify-content:flex-start}
.comingCard .listIcon{font-size:29px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#3e3657,#24213a)}
.comingCard .listInfo h3{font-size:22px;margin:0;line-height:1}
.comingCard .listInfo p{display:none}
.comingCard .chev{display:none}


.floatDeco{position:absolute;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.floatDeco.heart{font-size:44px;color:#ffb6d4;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,121,185,.38)}
.floatDeco.spark{font-size:26px;color:#ffe68e;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,221,120,.35)}
.h1{left:18px;top:34px;animation:floatHeartA 2.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.h2{right:14px;bottom:58px;font-size:34px;animation:floatHeartB 2.9s ease-in-out infinite}
.s1{right:34px;top:26px;animation:floatSparkA 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.s2{left:50px;bottom:20px;font-size:28px;animation:floatSparkB 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.s3{left:12px;top:150px;font-size:22px;animation:floatSparkC 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes floatHeartA{
  0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
  50%{transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.08)}
}
@keyframes floatHeartB{
  0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-8deg)}
  50%{transform:translateY(-8px) rotate(8deg)}
}
@keyframes floatSparkA{
  0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0) scale(1);opacity:.75}
  50%{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(16deg) scale(1.18);opacity:1}
}
@keyframes floatSparkB{
  0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(.92);opacity:.7}
  50%{transform:translateY(-12px) scale(1.25);opacity:1}
}
@keyframes floatSparkC{
  0%,100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:.7}
  50%{transform:translateX(5px) translateY(-8px) rotate(12deg);opacity:1}
}


.homeHeaderRow{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
}
.homeHeaderRow .homeTitleWrap{
  flex:1;
  text-align:center;
  padding-left:40px;
}
.homeReturnBtn{
  flex:0 0 40px;
  font-size:22px;
}


/* ===== v4.3 Sakura Theme ===== */
:root{
  --bg:#fff7f9;
  --bg2:#fdeef3;
  --panel:#fffafb;
  --panel2:#fce8ef;
  --line:#efcbd8;
  --text:#5a3f4c;
  --muted:#9d7f8c;
  --pink:#f48eb6;
  --pink2:#f8adc9;
  --violet:#cbb6ea;
  --blue:#b8d8f3;
  --yellow:#f6d99f;
  --green:#bfe5d2;
  --danger:#e8798f;
  --shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(177,110,137,.16);
}
html,body{
  background:#f8eaf0;
  color:var(--text);
}
#app{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% -12%,rgba(255,190,216,.72),transparent 34%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 42%,rgba(235,214,255,.45),transparent 28%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#fff9fb 0%,#fff3f6 58%,#fcecf2 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 65px rgba(171,112,139,.22);
}
#app::before{
  opacity:.44;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18px 18px,rgba(243,157,190,.26) 0 2px,transparent 3px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 7px 5px,rgba(201,179,231,.22) 0 1.5px,transparent 2px);
}
#splashPage{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,rgba(255,203,224,.68),transparent 34%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 25% 72%,rgba(230,214,250,.5),transparent 32%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#fffafb,#fdeff4);
}
.logo{
  color:#7c5266;
  text-shadow:0 3px 14px rgba(240,142,181,.2);
}
.logo span{color:#ec78a6}
.logoSub,.splashMini{color:#a27689}
.card{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,252,253,.98),rgba(255,243,247,.98));
  border-color:#efceda;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.primary{
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f7a9c6,#ef7fa9);
  border-color:#ffd4e3;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(239,127,169,.08),0 10px 24px rgba(222,120,159,.18),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.56);
}
.secondary{
  background:#fff8fa;
  border-color:#e8cbd6;
  color:#765565;
}
.iconBtn{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.62);
  border-color:#eccfd9;
  color:#80586a;
}
.muted{color:#aa8796}

/* Featured Bingo */
.featured{
  border-color:#ef9fbd;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(240,145,182,.15),0 12px 26px rgba(215,139,167,.15);
}
.featured::before{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 20%,rgba(255,220,177,.38),transparent 22%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 40%,rgba(255,182,210,.42),transparent 35%),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe8f0,#efdff5);
}
.gameTag{color:#8f6073}
.featured h2{
  color:#c95f8b;
  text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9);
}
.featured p{color:#815d6c}
.featuredArrow{
  color:#815d6c;
  background:#ffffffa8;
  border-color:#efd0dc;
}
.listCard{color:#634a56}
.listIcon{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fbeaf1,#eee4f7);
  border-color:#e6cdd9;
}
.listInfo p{color:#a18491}
.chev{color:#b693a2}
.disabledGame{opacity:.72}

/* Config */
.segBtn{
  background:#fff8fa;
  border-color:#e5cad5;
  color:#9b7c89;
}
.segBtn.active{
  color:#72485b;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd8e7,#f6a8c6);
  border-color:#f3b4cc;
  box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(239,139,179,.15);
}
.nickRow input{
  background:#fffdfd;
  border-color:#e7ccd7;
  color:#5a3f4c;
}
.nickRow input:focus{
  border-color:#ef95b8;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(239,149,184,.12);
}
.catDot{
  background:#fbe9f0;
  border-color:#e8cbd7;
}
.nickRow:nth-child(2) .catDot{background:#edf4fb}
.nickRow:nth-child(3) .catDot{background:#fff5dd}
.nickRow:nth-child(4) .catDot{background:#f1eafd}
.sizeCard{
  background:#fff9fb;
  border-color:#e6cbd6;
  color:#765765;
}
.sizeCard.active{
  border-color:#ee93b7;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ee93b7,0 0 16px rgba(239,139,179,.14);
}
.miniGrid i{background:#c7aeb9}
.sizeCard.active .miniGrid i{background:#ed8fb3}

/* Arrange */
.playerTab{
  background:#fff8fa;
  border-color:#e6cbd6;
  color:#9b7d89;
}
.playerTab.active{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe6ef,#f6b0cb);
  color:#70485a;
  border-color:#efb4cb;
}
.boardPanel{
  background:#fffafb;
  border-color:#e9cdd8;
}
.boardCell{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff7fa,#f8dce7);
  color:#654957;
  border-color:#f0d1dc;
}
.boardCell.selected{
  outline-color:#ed87af;
  background:#f8b7d0;
}
.arrangeHelp{color:#a08290}
.randomBtn{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d8c2ef,#c8a9e4);
  border-color:#d9c3eb;
  color:#5d476a;
}

/* Game */
.gamePageBg{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 16%,rgba(247,174,204,.38),transparent 28%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 36%,rgba(219,202,243,.35),transparent 34%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#fff7fa,#fdeef4);
}
.orb{
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 48% 38%,#fffefd 0%,#ffe5ef 52%,#f4c7dc 78%);
  border-color:#f4a7c6;
  box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(239,139,181,.36),0 0 30px rgba(205,177,235,.28),inset 0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,.9);
}
.orb::before{
  border-color:rgba(202,178,234,.78);
  box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(202,178,234,.25);
}
.drawNum{
  color:#cc6790;
  text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(255,255,255,.9);
}
.countText{color:#8b6a78}
.progress{background:#ead7df}
.progress i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d8c1ef,#ef8fb6)}
.playerBoardCard{
  background:#fffafb;
  border-color:#e7cbd7;
}
.playerBoardCard.p1{border-color:#ee99ba}
.playerBoardCard.p2{border-color:#b6cfe9}
.playerBoardCard.p3{border-color:#e8ce91}
.playerBoardCard.p4{border-color:#c9b1e9}
.bingoCount{color:#d86e99}
.gameCell{
  background:#fff8fa;
  border-color:#e6ccd6;
  color:#674b58;
}
.gameCell.marked{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffdce9,#f3a8c4);
  color:#5b3e4b;
  border-color:#efb4ca;
}
.historyTitle{color:#765665}
.numChip{
  background:#fff9fb;
  border-color:#e7ccd7;
  color:#907482;
}
.numChip.latest{
  background:#ef94b8;
  color:#fff;
  border-color:#ef94b8;
}

/* Winner */
#winPage{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,rgba(255,190,216,.55),transparent 34%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 25% 65%,rgba(246,218,159,.24),transparent 25%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#fff9fb,#fcecf3 72%);
}
.winnerWord{
  color:#e7a8ba;
  -webkit-text-stroke:2px #c96f91;
  text-shadow:0 5px 0 #f8dce6,0 0 22px rgba(232,152,183,.22);
}
.winnerName{color:#cf6f97}
.winMessage{color:#80616f}
.toast{
  background:#fff8fa;
  border-color:#e7cbd6;
  color:#684b59;
  box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(156,104,128,.18);
}

/* home mascot placement */
.splashMascot{
  transform:translateY(-28px);
  margin-bottom:-4px;
  overflow:visible;
}
.splashTitle{
  margin-top:-4px !important;
}
.splashMascot img{
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center center;
}
.featuredMascot img{
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center bottom;
  mix-blend-mode:normal;
  border-radius:0;
}

/* click heart effect */
.heartBurst{
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:42%;
  z-index:8;
  pointer-events:none;
  font-size:34px;
  color:#ef8fb6;
  text-shadow:0 0 13px rgba(239,143,182,.42);
  animation:heartBurstMove .78s cubic-bezier(.15,.8,.25,1) forwards;
}
@keyframes heartBurstMove_legacy{
  0%{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.45) rotate(0deg);
  }
  18%{
    opacity:1;
    transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--hx1)),calc(-50% + var(--hy1))) scale(1.12) rotate(var(--hr1));
  }
  100%{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--hx2)),calc(-50% + var(--hy2))) scale(.78) rotate(var(--hr2));
  }
}

@media(min-width:700px){
  body{
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%,#f8e5ed,#eadde7 68%);
  }
  #app{border-color:#e6cbd5}
}


/* ===== v4.4 Responsive Home ===== */
html,body{
  min-height:100%;
}
body{
  min-height:100dvh;
}

/* 앱은 모바일 비율을 유지하되 창이 좁아지면 같이 축소 */
#app{
  width:min(100vw,430px);
  min-height:100dvh;
  height:auto;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  overflow-y:visible;
}

.page{
  min-height:100dvh;
}

/* 홈 타이틀 화면은 브라우저 높이에 맞춰 각 영역 크기를 조절 */
.splashContent{
  min-height:calc(100dvh - max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top)));
  justify-content:center;
  gap:clamp(6px,1.6dvh,16px);
  padding:
    clamp(8px,1.8dvh,18px)
    clamp(14px,5vw,24px)
    clamp(14px,2.6dvh,28px);
}

/* 1145x1374 PNG 비율에 맞춰 너비/높이 모두 viewport 기준으로 제한 */
.splashMascot{
  width:min(84vw,355px,calc(47dvh * 0.8333));
  height:auto;
  aspect-ratio:1145 / 1374;
  max-height:47dvh;
  min-height:0;
  flex:0 1 auto;
  margin-top:0;
  margin-bottom:0;
  transform:none;
}

.splashMascot img{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  max-width:none;
  max-height:none;
  object-fit:contain;
  box-shadow:none;
  border-radius:0;
}

/* 이미지가 줄어들면 로고/버튼도 같이 줄어듦 */
.splashTitle{
  margin-top:0 !important;
  font-size:clamp(31px,10vw,47px);
  flex:0 0 auto;
}
.splashMini{
  margin-top:0;
  font-size:clamp(10px,3.1vw,13px);
}
.splashStart{
  margin-top:clamp(5px,1.4dvh,18px);
  min-height:clamp(46px,7.2dvh,55px);
  font-size:clamp(14px,4vw,17px);
  flex:0 0 auto;
}

/* 아주 낮은 창에서는 더 공격적으로 축소 */
@media (max-height:680px){
  .splashMascot{
    width:min(72vw,300px,calc(39dvh * 0.8333));
    max-height:39dvh;
  }
  .splashContent{
    gap:5px;
    padding-top:6px;
    padding-bottom:10px;
  }
  .splashStart{margin-top:4px}
}

/* 기존 데스크톱 미리보기의 고정 높이를 제거 */
@media(min-width:700px){
  body{
    padding:0;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    min-height:100dvh;
  }
  #app{
    min-height:100dvh;
    height:auto;
    border-radius:0;
  }
  .page{
    min-height:100dvh;
  }
  .splashContent{
    min-height:calc(100dvh - max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top)));
  }
}


/* ===== v4.4 Mascot Interaction ===== */

/* 평상시 idle */
.splashMascot img{
  animation:catIdle 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  transform-origin:50% 85%;
}

/* 클릭 중에는 idle 완전 중지 후 클릭 모션만 실행 */
.splashMascot.is-clicking img{
  animation:catPoke .58s ease-out 1 both !important;
}

/* 클릭 모션이 끝난 직후 원점으로 잠깐 복귀 */
.splashMascot.is-resetting img{
  animation:none !important;
  transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1deg) scale(1) !important;
}

/* 하트는 JS에서 정한 '캐릭터 외곽 좌표'에서 시작 */
.heartBurst{
  position:absolute;
  z-index:9;
  pointer-events:none;
  font-size:clamp(24px,8vw,35px);
  color:#ef8fb6;
  text-shadow:0 0 13px rgba(239,143,182,.42);
  transform-origin:center;
  animation:heartOuterBurst .82s cubic-bezier(.15,.8,.25,1) forwards;
}

@keyframes heartOuterBurst{
  0%{
    opacity:0;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.42) rotate(var(--rot0));
  }
  18%{
    opacity:1;
    transform:
      translate(
        calc(-50% + var(--dx1)),
        calc(-50% + var(--dy1))
      )
      scale(1.12)
      rotate(var(--rot1));
  }
  100%{
    opacity:0;
    transform:
      translate(
        calc(-50% + var(--dx2)),
        calc(-50% + var(--dy2))
      )
      scale(.72)
      rotate(var(--rot2));
  }
}





/* ===== v4.7.1 Paw Speech Bubble ===== */
.mascotSpeech{
  position:absolute;
  z-index:12;
  top:5%;
  left:50%;
  width:min(84%,292px);
  min-height:66px;
  padding:15px 44px 15px 18px;
  border-radius:24px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,253,254,.985),rgba(255,246,249,.985));
  border:2px solid #efb5cb;
  box-shadow:
    0 12px 26px rgba(191,117,146,.18),
    inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  color:#704d5d;
  font-size:clamp(12px,3.6vw,15px);
  line-height:1.45;
  font-weight:850;
  text-align:center;

  opacity:0;
  visibility:hidden;
  pointer-events:none;
  transform:translate(-50%,-10px) scale(.93);
  transition:
    opacity .24s ease,
    transform .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1.12),
    visibility 0s linear .28s;
}

.mascotSpeech.show{
  opacity:1;
  visibility:visible;
  transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1);
  transition:
    opacity .24s ease,
    transform .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1.12),
    visibility 0s;
}

.speechText{
  display:block;
  position:relative;
  z-index:4;
}

.speechPaw{
  position:absolute;
  right:12px;
  bottom:9px;
  z-index:4;
  font-size:26px;
  transform-origin:50% 70%;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(196,114,146,.14));
  animation:speechPawWiggle 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes speechPawWiggle{
  0%,100%{transform:rotate(-10deg) translateY(0)}
  50%{transform:rotate(7deg) translateY(-2px)}
}

@media(max-height:680px){
  .mascotSpeech{
    top:2%;
    width:min(80%,258px);
    min-height:56px;
    padding:12px 40px 12px 14px;
    font-size:12px;
  }
  .speechPaw{
    right:10px;
    bottom:7px;
    font-size:22px;
  }
}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .speechPaw{animation:none!important}
}


/* ===== v4.8.9 temporary self-diagnostic UI ===== */
.diagFloatBtn{
  position:absolute;z-index:70;
  top:max(14px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 8px));right:14px;
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:15px;
  border:1px solid #efb5cb;
  background:rgba(255,250,252,.94);
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(190,112,145,.16);
  color:#9d5875;font-size:19px;font-weight:950;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px)
}
.diagFloatBtn:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.diagFloatBtn::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;right:5px;top:5px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#75c98d;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff7fa
}
.diagOverlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:140;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 18px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  background:rgba(70,45,57,.28);backdrop-filter:blur(7px)
}
.diagOverlay.show{display:flex}
.diagCard{
  width:min(100%,390px);max-height:86dvh;overflow:auto;
  border-radius:26px;border:1px solid #efc7d6;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffafb,#fff3f7);
  box-shadow:0 20px 48px rgba(116,64,85,.24);
  padding:20px;color:#5a3f4c
}
.diagTitleRow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.diagTitle{font-size:20px;font-weight:950}
.diagClose{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #efd1dc;background:#fff;color:#8b6476;font-size:18px}
.diagSub{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:#927283;margin-bottom:12px}
.diagStatus{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.diagChip{padding:6px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#fbe2ec;border:1px solid #f2c6d6;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#965d74}
.diagChip.ok{background:#edf9f0;border-color:#c9e8d0;color:#4b8059}
.diagLogBox{
  width:100%;height:260px;resize:none;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #eed0dc;
  background:#fffdfd;color:#5b4650;padding:12px;font:11px/1.48 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;
  outline:none;white-space:pre;overflow:auto
}
.diagBtns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:12px}
.diagBtn{min-height:44px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #efc7d6;background:#fff;color:#795365;font-weight:900;font-size:13px}
.diagBtn.primaryDiag{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f7a6c5,#f18ab5);color:white;border-color:#ed91b5}
.diagBtn.dangerDiag{color:#a85b70;background:#fff5f7}
.diagFoot{margin-top:10px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.45;color:#a28390}


/* ===== v4.8.11 Settings / Exit + diagnostics ===== */
.mobileSettingsBtn{
  display:none;position:absolute;z-index:72;
  top:max(14px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 8px));left:14px;
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:15px;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border:1px solid #efb5cb;background:rgba(255,250,252,.94);
  color:#9d5875;font-size:21px;font-weight:900;
  box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(190,112,145,.15);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)
}
.mobileSettingsBtn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
@media (max-width:600px),(pointer:coarse){.mobileSettingsBtn{display:flex}}

.appModalOverlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:190;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 22px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  background:rgba(70,44,57,.30);backdrop-filter:blur(7px)
}
.appModalOverlay.show{display:flex;animation:exitFadeIn .18s ease-out both}
.appModalCard{
  width:min(100%,350px);border-radius:28px;padding:22px 20px 20px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffafb,#fff0f5);border:2px solid #efbfd1;
  box-shadow:0 24px 55px rgba(130,72,96,.24),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  color:#684655;text-align:center;position:relative;
  animation:exitPop .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1.15) both
}
.appModalClose{
  position:absolute;right:12px;top:10px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:12px;
  background:transparent;color:#aa7288;font-size:22px;font-weight:900
}
.settingsPaw{font-size:38px;margin:2px 0 6px;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 3px rgba(196,114,146,.12))}
.appModalTitle{font-size:22px;font-weight:1000;color:#714b5c;margin-bottom:8px}
.appModalDesc{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#9b7887;font-weight:750;margin:0 4px 18px}
.settingsExitBtn{
  width:100%;min-height:52px;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid #eeafc8;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffdbe8,#ffc9dc);color:#9a476a;font-size:15px;font-weight:950;
  box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(210,119,155,.12)
}
.exitFace{font-size:46px;line-height:1;margin:2px 0 10px}
.exitActions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.exitCancelBtn,.exitLeaveBtn{min-height:49px;border-radius:16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:950}
.exitCancelBtn{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8cbd6;color:#8c6c79}
.exitLeaveBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f49abb,#ec7dab);border:1px solid #ef91b5;color:white;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(221,95,145,.18)}
@keyframes exitFadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes exitPop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.94)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}


/* ===== v4.8.12 splash touch/click navigation ===== */
#splashPage{
  cursor:pointer;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
  touch-action:manipulation;
}
.splashMascot,
.mobileSettingsBtn{
  cursor:pointer;
}
.splashGoText{
  margin-top:clamp(8px,1.8dvh,18px);
  flex:0 0 auto;
  color:rgba(111,73,91,.72);
  font-size:clamp(15px,4.3vw,20px);
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  line-height:1.25;
  text-align:center;
  text-shadow:0 2px 9px rgba(255,255,255,.95),0 1px 16px rgba(220,133,168,.22);
  user-select:none;
  pointer-events:none;
  animation:splashGoBreathe 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes splashGoBreathe{
  0%,100%{opacity:.58;transform:translateY(0)}
  50%{opacity:.88;transform:translateY(-1px)}
}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  #splashPage{cursor:pointer}
  .splashMascot,.mobileSettingsBtn{cursor:pointer}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .splashGoText{animation:none!important;opacity:.76}
}


/* ===== v4.8.14 Colosseum ===== */
.colCard{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.14),rgba(255,255,255,.08));}
.colIcon{font-size:28px;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.28));}
.colHint{margin-top:8px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;text-align:center}
.stepPill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:12px;color:#ffe9ff;margin:0 auto 14px}
.playerCountWrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin-bottom:16px}
.playerCountNum{min-width:64px;text-align:center;font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:#fff1ff}
.playerCountRange{flex:1;accent-color:#ff9bd8}
.jobGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.jobCard{position:relative;padding:14px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);text-align:left;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;transition:transform .16s ease,border-color .16s ease,background .16s ease}
.jobCard.active{border-color:#ffb3df;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,179,223,.18),rgba(255,255,255,.08));transform:translateY(-2px)}
.jobEmoji{font-size:26px;line-height:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3))}
.jobMeta b{display:block;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:3px}
.jobMeta small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.35}
.colCta{margin-top:18px}
.rouletteArena,.bracketCard,.battleCard,.championCard{border-radius:24px;padding:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);box-shadow:0 22px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.ballRack{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:18px 0 10px}
.seedBall{width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.92),rgba(255,255,255,.18) 34%,rgba(255,255,255,.08));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);box-shadow:0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.22);font-weight:900;text-align:center;padding:6px;position:relative}
.seedBall.spin{animation:spinBall 1.1s linear infinite}
.seedBall .seedRank{position:absolute;top:6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(13,11,24,.66);font-size:10px;color:#ffd5ef}
.seedBall .seedFace{font-size:22px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:4px}
.seedBall .seedName{font-size:11px;line-height:1.15;color:#fff1ff;word-break:keep-all}
.seedOrderList{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.seedOrderItem{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px}
.seedOrderItem .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-weight:900}
.bracketList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
.matchRow{padding:14px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.matchTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;color:#fcd8ef;font-size:11px}
.duelNames{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-weight:800}
.duelNames .duelSlot{flex:1;padding:10px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);text-align:center}
.duelNames .duelVs{font-size:13px;opacity:.82}
.duelWinner{margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:#a6ffd2;font-weight:700}
.bracketAction{margin-top:16px}
.vsStage{min-height:calc(100vh - 120px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.vsCard{position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:100%;border-radius:28px;padding:28px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(13,11,24,.9),rgba(58,25,45,.72));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.vsSplit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:center}
.vsSplit:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:-18%;width:5px;height:136%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(255,198,221,.86),rgba(255,255,255,0));transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(18deg);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,180,211,.5)}
.vsFighter{text-align:center;padding:12px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.vsFighter .face{font-size:50px;margin-bottom:10px}
.vsFighter .name{font-size:18px;font-weight:900}
.vsFighter .seed{font-size:12px;color:#ffd7ee;margin-top:6px}
.bigVs{font-size:44px;font-weight:1000;color:#fff4fb;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,167,212,.46)}
.battleWrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.hpBoard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:end}
.hpLane{padding:14px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.hpLane.right{text-align:right}
.hpHead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:12px;color:#ffd7ee}
.hpLane.right .hpHead{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.hpName{font-weight:900;color:#fff6fb;font-size:15px}
.hpBar{height:14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.hpBar > i{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#76ffb7,#ffd27d,#ff7cc4);transition:width .35s ease}
.hpNum{margin-top:7px;font-size:12px;color:#fff0f8;font-weight:800}
.centerHud{padding:14px 10px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);text-align:center;min-width:122px}
.hudVs{font-size:18px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px}
.hudTimer{font-size:32px;font-weight:1000;line-height:1;margin:6px 0;color:#fff0fa}
.hudSub{font-size:11px;color:#ffd8ef;line-height:1.35}
.revealGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:stretch}
.revealCard{padding:14px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);min-height:98px}
.revealCard.right{text-align:right}
.actionTag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px}
.revealValue{font-size:30px;font-weight:1000}
.revealPending{opacity:.52;filter:blur(.5px)}
.animPanel{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:72px;padding:12px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05),rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-size:14px;text-align:center}
.animPanel.slash{box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(255,112,136,.22) inset}
.animPanel.guard{box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(120,196,255,.18) inset}
.battleControls{padding:16px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.choiceRow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.choiceBtn,.diceBtn{border:none;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff6fb;font-weight:900}
.choiceBtn.active,.diceBtn.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,176,222,.32),rgba(255,255,255,.1));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,191,229,.35) inset}
.diceBtn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;font-size:16px}
.dicePip{font-size:28px}
.battleHint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4}
.battleNotice{font-size:12px;color:#ffe0f0;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700}
.hiddenAiNotice{text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#ffd7ee;padding:8px 0}
.championCard{text-align:center}
.championFace{font-size:64px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px}
.championTitle{font-size:28px;font-weight:1000;margin-bottom:8px}
.championSub{font-size:13px;color:#ffd8ef;line-height:1.45}
.championBtns{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}
.championBtns > button{flex:1}
@keyframes spinBall{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media (max-width:420px){
  .seedBall{width:68px;height:68px}
  .seedOrderList{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .vsSplit{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}
  .hpBoard,.revealGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .centerHud{min-width:0}
}


/* ===== v4.8.15 Colosseum UI polish ===== */
/* Home: Colosseum receives the same premium card treatment as Bingo. */
.colFeatured{margin:0;min-height:155px;border-color:#d2b46f;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(191,156,79,.20),0 15px 32px rgba(116,83,117,.16)}
.colFeatured::before{background:radial-gradient(circle at 16% 18%,rgba(255,231,170,.58),transparent 24%),radial-gradient(circle at 82% 38%,rgba(181,203,255,.38),transparent 38%),linear-gradient(135deg,#fff1dc,#e7e3f8)}
.colFeatured .gameTag{color:#6c5870}
.colFeatured h2{font-size:34px;color:#755b86;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.92);letter-spacing:-.045em}
.colFeatured p{color:#65556d}
.colFeaturedMascot img{filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 18px rgba(85,63,98,.18));mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:.88}
.colSwordMark{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:91px;top:13px;font-size:28px;color:#856b47;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 7px rgba(98,72,36,.20));transform:rotate(-8deg)}
.colFeatured .featuredArrow{color:#654f72;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);border-color:#d7cbe4}

/* Colosseum palette: no low-contrast pink text on Sakura backgrounds. */
#colosseumSetupPage,#colosseumOrderPage,#colosseumBracketPage,#colosseumBattlePage,#colosseumChampionPage{--col-ink:#463c55;--col-sub:#72677f;--col-accent:#6b5d96;--col-gold:#a17739;--col-line:#d8d0e1}
#colosseumSetupPage .appbar h1,#colosseumOrderPage .appbar h1,#colosseumBracketPage .appbar h1,#colosseumBattlePage .appbar h1{color:#463c55}
#colosseumSetupPage .subhead,#colosseumOrderPage .subhead,#colosseumBracketPage .subhead,#colosseumBattlePage .subhead{color:#756a81}
#colosseumSetupPage .stepPill,#colosseumOrderPage .stepPill,#colosseumBracketPage .stepPill,#colosseumBattlePage .stepPill{background:#fffdf9;border-color:#d7ccbc;color:#695c51;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(91,75,63,.07)}
#colosseumSetupPage .sectionTitle,#colosseumOrderPage .sectionTitle,#colosseumBracketPage .sectionTitle{color:#463c55}
#colosseumSetupPage .muted{color:#766b80}
.playerCountWrap{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfd,#f6f1fa);border-color:#d8cfe1}
.playerCountNum{color:#5d4f86;text-shadow:none}
.playerCountRange{accent-color:#7561a6}
.jobCard{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfd,#f8f3f8);border-color:#ded5e3;color:#4e4358;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(90,70,95,.07)}
.jobCard.active{border-color:#8f7ab5;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f4effd,#eee8fa);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(119,96,166,.08),0 9px 20px rgba(82,64,104,.10)}
.jobMeta small{color:#786d82}
.colHint{color:#776d80}

/* Draw tokens: jewel/medal tokens instead of blank white eyeballs. */
.rouletteArena{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfb,#f6f1f8);border-color:#d9d0df;box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(83,62,91,.12)}
#colOrderStatus{color:#5d5369!important;font-weight:850}
.seedBall{width:78px;height:78px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 24%,#fff9d9 0 10%,#dfc683 11% 31%,#8f7aaa 32% 63%,#493f5d 64% 100%);border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(67,56,78,.18),inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(53,44,66,.22);color:#fff}
.seedBall.spin{animation:tokenFloat .72s ease-in-out infinite alternate,tokenTwist 1.35s linear infinite}
.seedTokenCore{width:35px;height:35px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);color:#7762a3;font-size:22px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
.seedBall .seedName{color:#fff;font-weight:900;text-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.seedBall .seedRank{background:#40364f;color:#fff0bf}
.seedOrderItem{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd4e3;color:#4d4258;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(75,59,85,.07)}
.seedOrderItem .badge{background:#5d4f7d;color:#fff}
@keyframes tokenFloat{from{translate:0 -3px}to{translate:0 4px}}
@keyframes tokenTwist{from{rotate:0deg}to{rotate:360deg}}

/* Bracket: cleaner tournament board, clearer status labels, no pink-on-black text. */
.bracketCard{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#272333,#1d1a28);border-color:#554b66;box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(37,29,44,.24);color:#f8f4fb}
#colosseumBracketPage .bracketCard .stepPill{background:#393244;border-color:#5f526b;color:#fff4d4;box-shadow:none}
#colBracketRoundTitle{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;margin:8px 0 16px!important;color:#fff}
.roundKicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#d5c28d;font-weight:1000}
#colBracketRoundTitle strong{font-size:27px;line-height:1;color:#fff}
#colBracketRoundTitle small{font-size:11px;color:#bdb4c7;font-weight:700}
.bracketList{gap:14px}
.matchRow{position:relative;padding:14px 14px 15px 17px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#332d3d,#292432);border:1px solid #51465c;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.16);overflow:hidden}
.matchRow::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:4px;background:linear-gradient(#c8aa62,#75639a)}
.matchRow.currentMatch{border-color:#a88b54;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(224,188,112,.16),0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.matchTop{margin-bottom:11px;color:#eee9f3}
.matchNo{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:1000;color:#e9e3ef}
.matchStatus{padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em;background:#494151;color:#e9e2ef}
.matchStatus.next{background:#b18b49;color:#211a0e}
.matchStatus.complete{background:#466c5a;color:#e9fff2}
.matchStatus.wait{background:#484250;color:#d6d0dd}
.matchStatus.byeStatus{background:#5a5275;color:#f6f1ff}
.bracketPair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 44px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.bracketPair.single{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.bracketFighter{position:relative;min-height:74px;border-radius:15px;padding:10px 8px;background:#211d29;border:1px solid #484052;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;color:#f7f2fa}
.bracketFighter.winner{border-color:#ad915b;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#342d35,#28232c)}
.seedChip{position:absolute;top:7px;left:7px;font-size:9px;color:#cfc5d8;background:#3a3443;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:999px}
.fighterAvatar{font-size:28px;line-height:1}
.fighterName{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;text-align:center;color:#fff}
.winnerMark{position:absolute;right:7px;top:7px;color:#ffe4a3;font-size:8px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em}
.bracketVs{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#726287,#3f364a);border:1px solid #8f7ca0;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.bracketVs span{font-size:11px;font-weight:1000;color:#fff7db}
.duelWinner{margin-top:10px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px solid #484052;color:#e8d39c;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;text-align:center}
#colNextMatchBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9b7d47,#665783);border-color:#d4bf8d}

/* VS screen: larger fighters and aggressive diagonal impact crack. */
#colosseumVsPage{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%,rgba(195,159,86,.15),transparent 27%),linear-gradient(160deg,#17141d,#251b27 48%,#15131c)}
.vsStage{min-height:calc(100svh - 34px)}
.vsCard{min-height:520px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#211924 0 47%,#171720 53% 100%);border:1px solid #594a5e;box-shadow:0 24px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.38);animation:vsImpact .48s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1)}
.vsCard::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:2;left:49%;top:-14%;width:24px;height:132%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#fff5d4 36%,#b89055 50%,#fff 64%,transparent);transform:rotate(20deg);clip-path:polygon(42% 0,100% 7%,54% 20%,96% 34%,35% 48%,83% 61%,30% 76%,70% 87%,20% 100%,0 100%,28% 83%,0 71%,48% 57%,8% 43%,57% 28%,17% 14%);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,231,184,.55))}
.vsCard::after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:1;left:50%;top:47%;width:170%;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,233,192,.75),transparent);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-18deg);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,211,148,.45)}
.vsSplit{position:relative;z-index:3;grid-template-columns:1fr 72px 1fr;gap:10px}
.vsSplit:before{display:none}
.vsFighter{min-height:290px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(255,255,255,.025));border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);box-shadow:inset 0 0 35px rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.vsFighter .face{font-size:88px;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.35));transform:scale(1.08)}
.vsFighter .name{font-size:20px;color:#fff;font-weight:1000}
.vsFighter .seed{color:#e4d5ae;font-weight:900}
.bigVs{font-size:48px;color:#fff4ce;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(220,180,104,.5),0 3px 0 #4f3e2b}
#colosseumVsPage .stepPill{position:absolute;z-index:4;top:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#27212d;border-color:#584c5e;color:#f6e8c5}
@keyframes vsImpact{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.92)}55%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.025)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}

/* Battle: readable neutral/gold text and controls immediately below HP. */
#colosseumBattlePage .battleCard{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#282331,#201c28);border-color:#554a61;box-shadow:0 20px 45px rgba(52,41,59,.22);color:#f8f4fb}
#colosseumBattlePage .hpLane{background:#332d3c;border-color:#574c63;color:#f8f4fb}
#colosseumBattlePage .hpHead{color:#d6cfdd}
#colosseumBattlePage .hpName{color:#fff}
#colosseumBattlePage .hpNum{color:#eee7f2}
#colosseumBattlePage .centerHud{background:#3a3241;border-color:#62556d;color:#fff}
#colosseumBattlePage .hudTimer{color:#fff4cf}
#colosseumBattlePage .hudSub{color:#d9d0e0;font-weight:850}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleControls{order:2;margin-top:0;padding:13px;background:#302a38;border-color:#554a61}
#colosseumBattlePage .revealGrid{order:3}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn,#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn{background:#453c4d;border:1px solid #64576f;color:#fff}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn.active,#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#75618a,#564664);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #a08bb1 inset}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleNotice{color:#fff3cf}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHint{color:#cbc2d1}
#colosseumBattlePage .hiddenAiNotice{color:#e5d9bd}
#colosseumBattlePage .revealCard{background:#312b39;border-color:#554a61;color:#fff}
#colosseumBattlePage .actionTag{background:#494151;color:#eee8f2}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel{background:#302a38;border-color:#554a61;color:#f3edf5}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.slash{box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(197,99,85,.19)}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.guard{box-shadow:inset 0 0 30px rgba(91,138,177,.18)}

/* Champion uses readable plum/bronze instead of pale pink. */
#colosseumChampionPage .championCard{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfb,#f2edf5);border-color:#d8cfdf;color:#4b4056}
#colosseumChampionPage .championTitle{color:#6a557b}
#colosseumChampionPage .winnerName{color:#8a672f}
#colosseumChampionPage .championSub{color:#6f6478}

@media (max-width:420px){
  .colFeatured h2{font-size:31px}
  .colFeatured .featuredText{width:61%}
  .colSwordMark{right:82px;font-size:25px}
  .vsCard{min-height:480px;padding:22px 14px}
  .vsSplit{grid-template-columns:1fr 56px 1fr!important;gap:7px}
  .vsFighter{min-height:250px;padding:8px}
  .vsFighter .face{font-size:74px}
  .vsFighter .name{font-size:15px}
  .bigVs{font-size:37px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .hpBoard{grid-template-columns:1fr 94px 1fr!important;gap:7px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .hpLane{padding:10px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .centerHud{min-width:0;padding:10px 5px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .hudTimer{font-size:28px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .revealGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 88px 1fr!important;gap:7px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .revealCard{padding:10px;min-height:88px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .revealValue{font-size:27px}
  .bracketFighter{min-height:68px;padding:9px 5px}
  .fighterAvatar{font-size:25px}
}



/* ===== v4.8.20 Sakura Colosseum VS + History + Patch Notes ===== */
#homePage .screen{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.homeVersion{margin-top:auto;padding-top:14px;align-self:flex-end;font-size:10px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#aa8d9a;opacity:.82}
.splashVersion{position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));font-size:10px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#aa8d9a;opacity:.82;pointer-events:none}

/* Settings patch-note accordion */
#settingsModal .appModalCard{max-height:calc(100svh - 70px);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.settingsPatchBtn{width:100%;min-height:50px;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid #e7cada;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fffafd,#f7effa);color:#765468;font-size:14px;font-weight:950;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 16px;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:0 7px 16px rgba(187,120,150,.08)}
.settingsPatchBtn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.patchChevron{font-size:18px;color:#a77a8f}
.settingsPatchPanel{display:none;text-align:left;margin:2px 0 12px;padding:8px;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ecd4df;box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.settingsPatchPanel.open{display:block;animation:patchDrop .18s ease-out both}
.patchVersion{border-radius:14px;background:#fff8fb;border:1px solid #f0dce5;margin:6px 0;overflow:hidden}
.patchVersion summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;min-height:42px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#704f60;font-size:13px;font-weight:1000}
.patchVersion summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.patchVersion summary::after{content:'＋';font-size:14px;color:#ae7d92;margin-left:auto}
.patchVersion[open] summary::after{content:'−'}
.patchVersion summary small{margin-left:8px;margin-right:auto;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:#f5b6ce;color:#7a4259;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.patchVersion ul{margin:0;padding:0 14px 11px 28px;color:#8b6c79;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;font-weight:750}
.patchVersion li+li{margin-top:3px}
@keyframes patchDrop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* Colosseum overall: return to Hu nyang's soft Sakura visual language. */
#colosseumSetupPage,#colosseumOrderPage,#colosseumBracketPage,#colosseumVsPage,#colosseumBattlePage,#colosseumChampionPage{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 18%,rgba(255,203,224,.45),transparent 27%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 62%,rgba(223,213,250,.46),transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#fff9fb 0%,#fff1f6 64%,#fbedf4 100%);
  color:#604857;
}
#colosseumSetupPage .stepPill,#colosseumOrderPage .stepPill,#colosseumBracketPage .stepPill{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff8fb,#f7eefc);border:1px solid #ead4e1;color:#806171;
  border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(182,116,145,.08)
}
#colosseumOrderPage .seedBall{background:radial-gradient(circle at 29% 23%,#fffdf4 0 12%,#ffdce8 13% 34%,#dbcdf0 35% 66%,#a687b0 67% 100%);border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(164,105,140,.13),inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.30)}
#colosseumOrderPage .seedBall .seedRank{background:#80617e;color:#fff8e8}

/* Bracket: cute tournament card instead of a dark board. */
.bracketCard{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfd,#fff4f8);border:1px solid #eccfdb;box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(179,108,137,.14);color:#604857;border-radius:28px}
#colosseumBracketPage .bracketCard .stepPill{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff9fc,#f3edf9);border-color:#ead6e2;color:#75596a;box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(178,119,146,.07)}
#colBracketRoundTitle{color:#684d5b!important}
.roundKicker{color:#b07a90}
#colBracketRoundTitle strong{color:#654855}
#colBracketRoundTitle small{color:#9d7e8d}
.matchRow{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fff8fb);border:1px solid #ead2dd;box-shadow:0 8px 19px rgba(171,104,132,.09);border-radius:20px;color:#634b58}
.matchRow::before{width:5px;background:linear-gradient(#f2a8c3,#cdb9eb)}
.matchRow.currentMatch{border-color:#eda7c1;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(239,157,189,.10),0 11px 23px rgba(176,103,132,.12)}
.matchTop{color:#775c69}
.matchNo{color:#704f60}
.matchStatus{background:#f2e9f0;color:#856c78}
.matchStatus.next{background:#ffe1eb;color:#934f6b}
.matchStatus.complete{background:#dff4e9;color:#4f7562}
.matchStatus.wait{background:#eee8f3;color:#75687e}
.matchStatus.byeStatus{background:#e9e0f7;color:#6e5b86}
.bracketFighter{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffafd,#f9edf3);border:1px solid #ead3de;color:#614a56;border-radius:18px}
.bracketFighter.winner{border-color:#edb0c6;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff7fb,#ffeaf2);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(241,172,197,.08)}
.seedChip{background:#f0e4ed;color:#8a6879}
.fighterName{color:#634a57}
.winnerMark{color:#c66f94}
.bracketVs{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#ffd7e6,#e6d9f5);border-color:#e8c9da;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(247,174,204,.09)}
.bracketVs span{color:#795567}
.duelWinner{border-top-color:#edd7e1;color:#a95f7d}
#colNextMatchBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f7a7c5,#d9bee9);border-color:#f4c4d6;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px rgba(123,72,96,.15)}

/* VS: Sakura arena, only the jagged slash remains. */
#colosseumVsPage{background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 50% 47%,rgba(255,229,170,.34),transparent 26%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 20% 32%,rgba(255,188,215,.46),transparent 33%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 82% 65%,rgba(216,204,248,.58),transparent 34%),
  linear-gradient(155deg,#fff9fb,#fbeef5 48%,#f3edfb)}
.vsStage{min-height:calc(100svh - 34px)}
.vsCard{min-height:500px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe9f2 0 48%,#eee7fb 52% 100%);border:2px solid rgba(236,190,210,.88);box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(178,108,138,.18),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.95);border-radius:34px}
.vsCard::before{left:49%;top:-14%;width:28px;height:132%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#fff 31%,#f4cf87 48%,#fff 67%,transparent);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(214,159,86,.38));opacity:.98}
.vsCard::after{display:none!important}
.vsFighter{min-height:300px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.58);border:1px solid rgba(223,188,207,.80);box-shadow:0 11px 25px rgba(175,111,140,.08),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-radius:24px}
.vsFighter .face{font-size:92px;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 13px rgba(120,79,99,.16));transform:scale(1.08)}
.vsFighter .name{color:#604553}
.vsFighter .seed{color:#9a7486}
.bigVs{color:#bd678b;text-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9),0 0 16px rgba(233,142,181,.24)}

/* Battle: soft cards, strong readability, controls close to HP. */
#colosseumBattlePage .battleCard{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfd,#fff5f8);border:1px solid #ebcfda;box-shadow:0 18px 39px rgba(178,109,138,.14);color:#604857;border-radius:28px}
#colosseumBattlePage .hpLane{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fff7fa);border:1px solid #ead3dd;color:#604857;border-radius:20px}
#colosseumBattlePage .hpHead{color:#846a77}
#colosseumBattlePage .hpName{color:#5f4552}
#colosseumBattlePage .hpNum{color:#755966}
#colosseumBattlePage .centerHud{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff8ed,#fff3f7);border:1px solid #ead3d2;color:#72515e;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 7px 16px rgba(179,111,137,.08)}
#colosseumBattlePage .hudTimer{color:#b46784;text-shadow:0 2px #fff}
#colosseumBattlePage .hudSub{color:#8f7280}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleControls{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fff7fb);border:1px solid #ead1dc;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(177,111,137,.07)}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleNotice{color:#7b5969}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHint{color:#9c7e8c}
#colosseumBattlePage .hiddenAiNotice{color:#8d6f7c}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn,#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn{color:#674b58;border-radius:18px;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(171,110,136,.08)}
#colosseumBattlePage #colAttackBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe4ec,#ffc5d6);border:1px solid #efb4c8}
#colosseumBattlePage #colDefendBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e8f8f0,#ccebdc);border:1px solid #badfce}
#colosseumBattlePage #colDiceBtn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1eafb,#e0d4f3);border:1px solid #d3c3ea}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn.active,#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn.active{color:#5c4050;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(224,140,174,.16),0 7px 16px rgba(178,111,139,.09);transform:translateY(-1px)}
#colosseumBattlePage .revealGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 68px 1fr!important;gap:9px;align-items:stretch}
#colosseumBattlePage .revealCard{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff9fc,#fbeef4);border:1px solid #ead1dc;color:#664c58;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 7px 15px rgba(175,108,136,.07)}
#colosseumBattlePage .revealCard.right{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#faf8ff,#f1ecfb);border-color:#ddd1ee}
#colosseumBattlePage .actionTag{background:#f2e6ed;color:#765866}
.revealVsCore{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:88px;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff8f1,#fff0f6);border:1px solid #ead2d9;box-shadow:0 7px 15px rgba(173,108,134,.07)}
.revealVsCore span{font-size:22px;font-weight:1000;color:#b56785;text-shadow:0 2px #fff}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.battleLogBar{order:4;width:100%;min-height:48px;margin-top:-2px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff8fb,#f8f0fc);border:1px solid #e8d2df;color:#725765;box-shadow:0 7px 15px rgba(174,108,136,.07);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:11px;font-weight:850;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.battleLogBar.slash{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff2f3,#ffe9ee);box-shadow:0 7px 15px rgba(190,105,125,.08)}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.battleLogBar.guard{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#eef9f5,#eff6ff);box-shadow:0 7px 15px rgba(104,154,155,.08)}

/* Champion stays celebratory and light. */
#colosseumChampionPage .championCard{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfd,#fff0f6);border:2px solid #efc8d8;box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(183,109,141,.15);border-radius:32px}
#colosseumChampionPage .championTitle{color:#b45f82}
#colosseumChampionPage .winnerName{color:#72516a}
#colosseumChampionPage .championSub{color:#927483}

@media (max-width:420px){
  .vsCard{min-height:470px;padding:18px 12px}
  .vsFighter{min-height:245px}
  .vsFighter .face{font-size:76px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .revealGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 58px 1fr!important;gap:7px}
  .revealVsCore{min-height:88px}
  .revealVsCore span{font-size:20px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.battleLogBar{font-size:10px;padding-inline:10px}
}


/* ===== v4.8.18 Battle UX hotfix ===== */
/* The round message must belong to the same soft Sakura family, never the old dark arena panel. */
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff8fb,#f7f1fc);
  border:1px solid #ead3df;
  color:#725765;
  box-shadow:0 7px 16px rgba(176,110,139,.07);
}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.battleLogBar{
  min-height:52px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff9fc,#f8f1fc);
  border-color:#ead2df;
  color:#6f5361;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.battleLogBar.slash{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff1f4,#ffe8ee);
  color:#7a4b5c;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .animPanel.battleLogBar.guard{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#eef9f5,#f1f7ff);
  color:#526b6c;
}

/* Clear selection state: pressed tone + translucent paw + check mark. */
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn{
  position:relative;
  isolation:isolate;
  overflow:hidden;
  min-height:68px;
  transition:transform .12s ease,filter .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease,background .12s ease;
  opacity:1;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn > *,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn > *{
  position:relative;
  z-index:3;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn::before,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn::before{
  content:'🐾';
  position:absolute;
  z-index:1;
  left:50%;
  top:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-48%) scale(.78);
  font-size:62px;
  line-height:1;
  opacity:0;
  filter:grayscale(.18);
  pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .12s ease,transform .12s ease;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn::after,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn::after{
  content:'✓';
  position:absolute;
  z-index:4;
  right:10px;
  top:8px;
  width:24px;
  height:24px;
  border-radius:999px;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  background:#fff;
  color:#9b5674;
  border:1px solid rgba(155,86,116,.22);
  box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(126,78,98,.12);
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:1000;
  opacity:0;
  transform:scale(.7);
  pointer-events:none;
  transition:opacity .12s ease,transform .12s ease;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn.active::before,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn.active::before{
  opacity:.18;
  transform:translate(-50%,-48%) scale(1);
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn.active::after,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn.active::after{
  opacity:1;
  transform:scale(1);
}
#colosseumBattlePage #colAttackBtn.active{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#efb8c8,#e7a4ba);
  border-color:#d894ab;
  color:#543944;
  box-shadow:inset 0 3px 7px rgba(104,54,72,.12),0 0 0 3px rgba(224,140,174,.15);
  transform:translateY(2px);
}
#colosseumBattlePage #colDefendBtn.active{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#bfe3d3,#a9d5c2);
  border-color:#91c5ae;
  color:#385a4c;
  box-shadow:inset 0 3px 7px rgba(50,101,80,.12),0 0 0 3px rgba(112,190,155,.13);
  transform:translateY(2px);
}
#colosseumBattlePage #colDiceBtn.active{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d8c8ee,#c7b3e5);
  border-color:#b6a0d7;
  color:#51405f;
  box-shadow:inset 0 3px 7px rgba(82,59,107,.12),0 0 0 3px rgba(164,134,205,.13);
  transform:translateY(2px);
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn:disabled,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn:disabled{
  cursor:default;
  filter:saturate(.78);
  opacity:.58;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn.active:disabled,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn.active:disabled{
  opacity:1;
  filter:none;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceText{
  color:inherit;
  text-shadow:0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.65);
}
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn.rolling .dicePip{
  animation:colDiceWiggle .34s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes colDiceWiggle{
  from{transform:rotate(-14deg) scale(.94)}
  to{transform:rotate(14deg) scale(1.08)}
}


/* ===== v4.8.19 Colosseum UI / flow fixes ===== */
/* Action controls keep a fixed footprint whether selected or not. */
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceRow{
  width:100%;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);
}
#colosseumBattlePage .choiceBtn,
#colosseumBattlePage .diceBtn{
  width:100%;
  min-width:0;
  max-width:100%;
  box-sizing:border-box;
}
#colosseumBattlePage #colDiceBtn{
  width:100%;
  margin:0 0 16px 0;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHint{
  margin-top:2px;
}
/* Pressed state may move vertically only. Never scale or change horizontal size. */
#colosseumBattlePage #colAttackBtn.active,
#colosseumBattlePage #colDefendBtn.active,
#colosseumBattlePage #colDiceBtn.active{
  width:100%;
  transform:translateY(2px);
}


/* ===== v4.8.20 VS composition + battle history ===== */
/* VS: remove the rounded fighter tiles and use the broad diagonal arena. */
#colosseumVsPage .vsCard{
  min-height:520px;
  overflow:hidden;
}
#colosseumVsPage .vsSplit{
  position:relative;
  min-height:470px;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 64px minmax(0,1fr);
  align-items:center;
  gap:2px;
  z-index:2;
}
#colosseumVsPage .vsFighter{
  min-height:0;
  padding:10px 2px;
  border:0!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
}
#colosseumVsPage .vsFighterLeft{transform:translateY(-58px)}
#colosseumVsPage .vsFighterRight{transform:translateY(58px)}
#colosseumVsPage .vsFighter .face{
  font-size:104px;
  margin-bottom:8px;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 13px 14px rgba(120,79,99,.18));
}
#colosseumVsPage .vsFighter .name{
  padding:4px 10px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.54);
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(164,105,134,.08);
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.2;
}
#colosseumVsPage .vsFighter .seed{margin-top:6px;font-size:12px}
#colosseumVsPage .bigVs{
  position:relative;
  width:64px;
  height:230px;
  display:block;
  font-size:0;
  z-index:4;
  pointer-events:none;
}
#colosseumVsPage .bigVs span{
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-7deg);
  font-size:48px;
  line-height:1;
  font-weight:1000;
  color:#bd678b;
  text-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95),0 0 16px rgba(233,142,181,.25);
}
#colosseumVsPage .vsLetterV{top:36px;margin-left:-9px}
#colosseumVsPage .vsLetterS{bottom:34px;margin-left:9px}

/* Battle history: newest result stays on top, older rounds scroll below. */
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryPanel{
  order:5;
  width:100%;
  margin-top:2px;
  padding:12px;
  border-radius:20px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfd,#fff5f9);
  border:1px solid #ead1dc;
  box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(177,111,137,.07);
  color:#674e5a;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryHead{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:8px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:1000;
  color:#704f60;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryHead small{
  color:#a17e8d;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:800;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryList{
  max-height:148px;
  overflow-y:auto;
  overscroll-behavior:contain;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  gap:7px;
  padding-right:2px;
  scrollbar-width:thin;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryEmpty{
  padding:13px 10px;
  text-align:center;
  color:#a18692;
  font-size:10px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:#fbf2f6;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryItem{
  padding:10px 11px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:#fbf2f6;
  border:1px solid #efdee6;
  color:#6b5360;
  font-size:10px;
  line-height:1.45;
  font-weight:780;
  word-break:keep-all;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryItem.latest{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffeaf2,#f1eafb);
  border-color:#edc4d5;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(233,155,187,.08);
  color:#604553;
}
#colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryRound{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  min-width:31px;
  margin-right:6px;
  padding:2px 6px;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#fff;
  color:#a75e7d;
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:1000;
  vertical-align:1px;
}
@media (max-width:420px){
  #colosseumVsPage .vsCard{min-height:500px;padding:14px 8px}
  #colosseumVsPage .vsSplit{min-height:450px;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 54px minmax(0,1fr)}
  #colosseumVsPage .vsFighterLeft{transform:translateY(-52px)}
  #colosseumVsPage .vsFighterRight{transform:translateY(52px)}
  #colosseumVsPage .vsFighter .face{font-size:88px}
  #colosseumVsPage .vsFighter .name{font-size:15px;padding:4px 8px}
  #colosseumVsPage .bigVs{width:54px;height:210px}
  #colosseumVsPage .bigVs span{font-size:42px}
  #colosseumVsPage .vsLetterV{top:31px;margin-left:-7px}
  #colosseumVsPage .vsLetterS{bottom:30px;margin-left:7px}
  #colosseumBattlePage .battleHistoryList{max-height:132px}
}



/* ===== v4.8.22 RPG Field/Battle Prototype ===== */
.rpgFeatured{margin:0;min-height:155px;border-color:#cdb991;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(143,118,79,.18),0 15px 32px rgba(92,76,116,.14)}
.rpgFeatured::before{background:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 18%,rgba(255,239,183,.72),transparent 25%),radial-gradient(circle at 83% 42%,rgba(187,221,199,.52),transparent 38%),linear-gradient(135deg,#fff4d9,#e8efe0 54%,#e6ddf5)}
.rpgFeatured .gameTag{color:#6c5b6e}
.rpgFeatured h2{font-size:39px;color:#66547f;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95);letter-spacing:-.045em}
.rpgFeatured p{color:#62586b;font-weight:780}
.rpgFeaturedMascot{right:-2px;bottom:-4px;width:45%;height:150px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:visible}
.rpgFeaturedHero{position:relative;z-index:2;font-size:82px;line-height:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 13px rgba(81,65,89,.20));transform:translateY(5px)}
.rpgFeaturedSpark{position:absolute;z-index:3;font-size:23px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(85,70,96,.14))}
.rpgSparkOne{right:16px;top:19px;transform:rotate(12deg)}
.rpgSparkTwo{left:8px;bottom:22px;font-size:27px;transform:rotate(-18deg)}
.rpgFeatured .featuredArrow{color:#615474;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);border-color:#d8cde2}
@media(max-width:365px){.rpgFeaturedHero{font-size:72px}.rpgFeatured p{font-size:11px}.rpgFeatured h2{font-size:35px}}
#rpgNamePage,#rpgGenderPage,#rpgJobPage,#rpgStatsPage,#rpgAiPage,#rpgVillagePage,#rpgStatusPage,#rpgNpcPage,#rpgGuildPage,#rpgReceptionPage,#rpgDialoguePage,#rpgQuestGuidePage,#rpgQuestAcceptedPage,#rpgFormationPage,#rpgFieldPage{
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 18% 12%,rgba(255,222,202,.55),transparent 29%),radial-gradient(circle at 83% 58%,rgba(221,210,250,.50),transparent 32%),linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf8 0%,#fff3f7 62%,#f8edf5 100%);color:#5d4855
}
.rpgHeadTitle{color:#604a58!important}.rpgSub{color:#977784!important}
.rpgPanel{margin:10px 0 14px;padding:17px;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fff8fb);border:1px solid #ecd6df;box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(165,106,132,.11)}
.rpgKicker{font-size:9px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#b07a91;margin-bottom:5px}.rpgBig{font-size:25px;font-weight:1000;color:#654d5c;line-height:1.15}.rpgDesc{margin-top:8px;color:#8d7380;font-size:12px;font-weight:720;line-height:1.58}
.rpgTextInput{width:100%;height:54px;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid #e6cdd8;background:#fff;color:#604a58;padding:0 15px;font-size:17px;font-weight:900;outline:none;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 5px rgba(125,78,100,.04)}
.rpgTextInput:focus{border-color:#d699b3;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(226,152,184,.12)}
.rpgError{min-height:20px;margin:6px 3px 2px;color:#bd617c;font-size:10px;font-weight:850}
.rpgChoiceGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:12px 0}.rpgGenderBtn,.rpgStatBtn{min-height:80px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid #e9d3dd;background:#fff9fc;color:#684f5d;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 8px 19px rgba(171,104,132,.08)}
.rpgGenderBtn{font-size:15px}.rpgGenderBtn span{display:block;font-size:27px;margin-bottom:4px}.rpgGenderBtn.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe9f1,#f3eafd);border-color:#dca4ba;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(218,152,181,.10),0 9px 20px rgba(155,99,127,.10)}
.rpgDiceStage{text-align:center;padding:18px 10px}.rpgDice{width:96px;height:96px;margin:4px auto 12px;border-radius:28px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#f5e7ef);border:1px solid #e6ced9;box-shadow:0 16px 28px rgba(143,91,116,.14);font-size:48px;font-weight:1000;color:#74566a}.rpgDice.rolling{animation:rpgDiceShake .13s linear infinite}@keyframes rpgDiceShake{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-3deg) translateY(0)}50%{transform:rotate(3deg) translateY(-3px)}}
