.rpgJobResult{min-height:66px;text-align:center}.rpgJobName{font-size:23px;font-weight:1000;color:#624b59}.rpgJobName.hiddenJob{color:#8c62a7;text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(137,91,172,.14)}.rpgJobDesc{margin-top:5px;color:#937986;font-size:11px;font-weight:760}
.rpgMap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin:10px 0}.rpgMap div{padding:8px 4px;border-radius:12px;background:#f8eef4;border:1px solid #ead9e1;text-align:center;color:#876d79;font-size:9px;font-weight:900}.rpgMap div:last-child{grid-column:2/3}
.rpgStatBoard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:5px;margin:10px 0}.rpgStatCell{padding:9px 2px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ead5df;text-align:center}.rpgStatCell b{display:block;color:#715667;font-size:9px}.rpgStatCell strong{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#5b4754;font-size:18px}.rpgStatAssign{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:5px;margin:10px 0}.rpgStatBtn{min-height:52px;padding:5px 1px;font-size:10px}.rpgStatBtn:disabled{opacity:.42}.rpgStatBtn:not(:disabled):active{transform:translateY(2px);background:#f7eaf1}
.rpgRollHistory{min-height:34px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:14px;background:#fbf4f8;color:#967786;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.5}.rpgCurrentRoll{text-align:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#846676;margin:8px 0}.rpgCurrentRoll strong{font-size:24px;color:#624b59}
.rpgPartyCards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:10px 0}.rpgPartyCard{padding:12px;border-radius:18px;background:#fff9fc;border:1px solid #e9d5df}.rpgPartyCard .who{font-size:9px;color:#a27d8f;font-weight:1000}.rpgPartyCard .name{font-size:14px;color:#634b59;font-weight:1000;margin-top:3px}.rpgPartyCard .job{font-size:11px;color:#8d7080;font-weight:850;margin-top:2px}.rpgAiRolling{text-align:center;padding:13px;border-radius:16px;background:#f9eff6;color:#8b6d7d;font-size:11px;font-weight:900}.rpgAiRolling.active::after{content:' ·';animation:rpgDots 1s steps(3,end) infinite}@keyframes rpgDots{0%{content:' ·'}33%{content:' ··'}66%,100%{content:' ···'}}
.rpgStoryBox{padding:18px;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffdfb,#fff7f9);border:1px solid #ecd7de;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(151,99,120,.10);font-family:Georgia,"Noto Serif KR",serif}.rpgStoryBox h2{margin:0 0 10px;color:#644c59;font-size:21px}.rpgStoryBox p{margin:8px 0;color:#765e6a;font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;font-weight:650}.rpgNpcLine{margin:10px 0;padding:13px 15px;border-left:4px solid #e4adc2;border-radius:0 16px 16px 0;background:#fff7fb;color:#725765;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:760}
.rpgActionStack{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:14px}.rpgActionBtn{width:100%;min-height:54px;border-radius:17px;border:1px solid #e8cfda;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fff7fb);color:#674e5b;font-size:12px;font-weight:950;padding:10px 13px;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 7px 17px rgba(160,103,128,.07)}.rpgActionBtn:active{transform:translateY(2px);background:#f9edf3}.rpgActionBtn.primaryChoice{text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f7bfd3,#d9c7f0);border-color:#ddadc2;color:#684b5b}
.rpgDialogueChoices{display:grid;gap:9px;margin:12px 0}.rpgDialogueChoice{width:100%;min-height:62px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #ead3dd;background:#fff;color:#644d5a;padding:12px 14px;text-align:left;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;font-weight:850;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(160,103,128,.07)}.rpgDialogueChoice:active{transform:translateY(2px);background:#f9edf4}.rpgDialogueChoice[disabled]{opacity:.55}
.rpgQuestGradeRow{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:9px 0}.rpgGrade{min-width:31px;padding:6px 7px;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;background:#f7edf3;border:1px solid #e7d3dc;color:#846b77;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000}.rpgGrade.high{background:#f0e7fa;color:#6f5a86}.rpgQuestCard{padding:15px;border-radius:21px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffaf2,#fff7fb);border:1px solid #e8d1c7;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(150,102,95,.09)}.rpgQuestCard .grade{display:inline-flex;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#e9d7bd;color:#705b3e;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000}.rpgQuestCard h3{margin:8px 0 5px;color:#654f58;font-size:17px}.rpgQuestCard p{margin:4px 0;color:#8d747e;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;font-weight:740}.rpgQuestRules{margin:10px 0;padding:12px;border-radius:16px;background:#fbf3f7;color:#876d79;font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:780}
.rpgAcceptedIcon{text-align:center;font-size:62px;margin:12px 0 4px}.rpgAcceptedTitle{text-align:center;color:#624a58;font-size:24px;font-weight:1000}.rpgAcceptedSub{text-align:center;color:#917683;font-size:11px;font-weight:780;line-height:1.6;margin:7px 0 14px}

/* ===== v4.8.22 RPG formation / field / battle ===== */
.rpgFormationLegend{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin:11px 0 5px;text-align:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000;color:#947783}
.rpgFormationLegend span:first-child{color:#7b75a0}.rpgFormationLegend span:last-child{color:#a96275}
.rpgMemberPicker{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}
.rpgMemberChip{flex:1;min-width:128px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #e7d1dc;background:#fff9fc;color:#654e5b;text-align:left;font-weight:950}
.rpgMemberChip.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe0ec,#eee2fb);border-color:#d89ab5;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(214,145,176,.12)}
.rpgMemberChip small{display:block;color:#997b89;font-size:8px;margin-top:3px}
.rpgFormationGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px;padding:10px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f1effc,#fff8fb 50%,#fff0ef);border:1px solid #ead4df}
.rpgFormationCell{position:relative;min-height:76px;border-radius:17px;border:1px dashed #d9c5d0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#9a7f8b;font-size:8px;font-weight:900;overflow:hidden}
.rpgFormationCell.front{background:rgba(255,238,238,.75)}.rpgFormationCell.rear{background:rgba(242,240,255,.78)}
.rpgFormationCell.occupied{border-style:solid;border-color:#dbadbf;background:#fff}
.rpgFormationAvatar{font-size:25px;line-height:1}.rpgFormationName{margin-top:4px;font-size:9px;color:#664d59;font-weight:1000}
.rpgDerivedBox{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin:10px 0}
.rpgDerivedStat{padding:8px 5px;border-radius:13px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ead6df;text-align:center}
.rpgDerivedStat b{display:block;font-size:8px;color:#967987}.rpgDerivedStat strong{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:13px;color:#604a56}
.rpgTimeBadge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:#f6eaf1;color:#795f6c;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000}
.rpgRouteWrap{margin:9px 0 8px;padding:10px 8px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);border:1px solid #e9d7df;overflow-x:auto}
.rpgRouteTrack{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;min-width:max-content;padding:0 4px}
.rpgRouteStep{position:relative;width:58px;text-align:center;flex:0 0 58px;color:#9b808d;font-size:7px;font-weight:900}
.rpgRouteStep:not(:last-child)::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:17px;left:40px;width:36px;height:3px;border-radius:9px;background:#eadce3}
.rpgRouteDot{position:relative;z-index:2;width:35px;height:35px;margin:0 auto 5px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fff;border:2px solid #ddc9d3;font-size:15px;color:#8d7481}
.rpgRouteStep.done .rpgRouteDot{background:#e8c7d7;border-color:#d79ab4;color:#fff}.rpgRouteStep.current .rpgRouteDot{background:#fff0f6;border-color:#c97e9f;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(220,145,176,.13)}
.rpgRouteLabel{max-width:56px;line-height:1.2}.rpgRouteStep.done:not(.current) .rpgRouteLabel{color:#b08195}
.rpgScene{position:relative;min-height:250px;border-radius:25px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #d9d9c9;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#cae7ff 0 45%,#dff3ca 46% 68%,#abd582 69%);box-shadow:0 13px 28px rgba(92,113,83,.10)}
.rpgScene.noon{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#bfe8ff 0 44%,#eef7c9 45% 67%,#a7d578 68%)}
.rpgScene.night{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#343956 0 46%,#566b65 47% 67%,#3d6048 68%);color:#fff}
.rpgScene.dawn{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7f769d 0 28%,#e8aeb2 29% 48%,#d9d6a5 49% 67%,#65875e 68%);color:#fff}
.rpgSceneDecor{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}.rpgSceneDecor .cloud{position:absolute;top:16px;left:10%;font-size:34px;opacity:.75}.rpgSceneDecor .mount{position:absolute;top:72px;right:5%;font-size:72px;opacity:.38}.rpgSceneDecor .grass{position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:0;right:0;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:14px;white-space:nowrap;opacity:.65}
.rpgSceneTitle{position:absolute;left:12px;top:10px;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);color:#69545e;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000}
.rpgCombatFormation{position:absolute;top:50px;bottom:22px;width:42%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr);gap:5px;padding:6px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s ease}
.rpgCombatFormation.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}.rpgCombatFormation.party{left:5px}.rpgCombatFormation.enemy{right:5px}
.rpgCombatUnit{position:relative;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);border:1px solid rgba(112,86,101,.18);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:0;padding:3px}
.rpgCombatUnit.empty{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-style:dashed}.rpgCombatUnit.targetable{outline:3px solid rgba(219,90,117,.42);cursor:pointer;animation:rpgTargetPulse .8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes rpgTargetPulse{to{transform:scale(1.04)}}
.rpgUnitIcon{font-size:21px;line-height:1}.rpgUnitName{max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;margin-top:2px;font-size:7px;font-weight:1000;color:#5e4b55}
.rpgMiniHp{width:90%;height:5px;border-radius:99px;background:#e7d9de;overflow:hidden;margin-top:3px}.rpgMiniHp i{display:block;height:100%;background:#df7897;border-radius:99px}
.rpgUnitStatus{min-height:9px;font-size:6px;color:#856d78;margin-top:2px}
.rpgDamageFloat{position:absolute;z-index:9;top:-10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:16px;font-weight:1000;color:#bb3459;text-shadow:0 2px 0 #fff;pointer-events:none;animation:rpgDamageUp .75s ease-out forwards}
.rpgDamageFloat.heal{color:#4c9e6a}
@keyframes rpgDamageUp{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,8px) scale(.8)}25%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-26px) scale(1.08)}}
.rpgFieldControls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 82px minmax(0,1fr);gap:7px;margin:8px 0;align-items:stretch}
.rpgBattleBox,.rpgPartyStatusBox{min-height:170px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #ead4de;background:#fff9fc;padding:8px}
.rpgBattleActions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px}.rpgBattleAction{min-height:42px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid #e6d1da;background:#fff;color:#6b5360;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000;padding:4px}
.rpgBattleAction:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(2px);background:#f7eaf1}.rpgBattleAction:disabled{opacity:.38}
.rpgBattleHint{margin-top:7px;font-size:8px;line-height:1.4;color:#9a7e8b;font-weight:800}
.rpgCenterActions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;justify-content:center}
.rpgCenterBtn{width:100%;min-height:74px;border-radius:19px;border:1px solid #d9b9c7;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffe4ef,#f1def7);color:#694f5d;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(153,99,124,.10)}
.rpgCenterBtn:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(3px) scale(.98);box-shadow:0 3px 7px rgba(153,99,124,.10)}.rpgCenterBtn:disabled{opacity:.48}
.rpgCenterBtn.danger{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffdcd8,#f6c6cb);border-color:#dea6ab}.rpgCenterBtn.safe{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e7f5e5,#cfe8d1);border-color:#b9d2bc}
.rpgPartyStatus{padding:6px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0e1e7}.rpgPartyStatus:last-child{border-bottom:0}.rpgStatusTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;font-size:8px;font-weight:1000;color:#684f5c}
.rpgBar{height:7px;margin-top:4px;border-radius:99px;background:#eadfe4;overflow:hidden}.rpgBar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px}.rpgBar.hp i{background:#df7897}.rpgBar.mp i{background:#8f91d8}
.rpgStatusEffect{min-height:11px;margin-top:4px;font-size:7px;color:#957b88;font-weight:800}
.rpgHistory{max-height:130px;overflow:auto;padding:9px;border-radius:17px;background:#faf2f6;border:1px solid #ead7df}
.rpgHistoryTitle{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000;color:#79606c}
.rpgHistoryRow{padding:6px 7px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;margin-bottom:5px;color:#806875;font-size:8px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.45}.rpgHistoryRow:first-of-type{background:#fff1f6;color:#6c4e5c;border:1px solid #edd0dc}
.rpgFieldSummary{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:7px 0}.rpgFieldSummary span{padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:#f8edf3;color:#846a77;font-size:8px;font-weight:1000}
.rpgQuestDone{padding:13px;border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff0c9,#f4e2ff);border:1px solid #ead3b2;color:#715d55;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.55;margin:8px 0}
@media(max-width:365px){.rpgFieldControls{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 68px minmax(0,1fr);gap:5px}.rpgBattleBox,.rpgPartyStatusBox{padding:6px}.rpgBattleAction{font-size:8px}.rpgCenterBtn{font-size:10px}.rpgRouteStep{width:52px;flex-basis:52px}.rpgRouteStep:not(:last-child)::after{width:30px}}

@media(max-width:365px){.rpgStatCell strong{font-size:15px}.rpgStatCell b,.rpgStatBtn{font-size:8px}.rpgPanel{padding:14px}.rpgBig{font-size:22px}}

/* ===== v4.8.23 village / mobile continuity ===== */
html,body{overscroll-behavior-y:none!important;overscroll-behavior-x:none}
body{touch-action:pan-y pinch-zoom}
#rpgVillagePage .screen,#rpgStatusPage .screen,#rpgNpcPage .screen{padding-bottom:28px}
.rpgVillageHero{padding:18px;border-radius:25px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff9f1,#f6f2df 48%,#f1e5ef);border:1px solid #ead8d4;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(126,94,94,.09);margin-bottom:12px}
.rpgVillageScene{min-height:160px;border-radius:21px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#cdeaff 0 48%,#e7f1c9 49% 68%,#ccb48d 69%);position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:16px;margin-top:10px}
.rpgVillageScene .villageSky{position:absolute;inset:8px 12px auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:34px;opacity:.86}.rpgVillageScene .villageTown{position:relative;font-size:46px;letter-spacing:3px;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 8px rgba(94,74,59,.12))}
.rpgVillageTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:7px 0 12px}.rpgVillageGold{padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff2c7;border:1px solid #ead39a;color:#756039;font-size:10px;font-weight:1000}.rpgVillageClock{padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:#f4ebf4;border:1px solid #e3d2e0;color:#735e6b;font-size:10px;font-weight:1000}
.rpgVillageGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:12px}.rpgVillageAction{min-height:78px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #e5d1da;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fff7fa);color:#684f5d;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;padding:10px;box-shadow:0 7px 15px rgba(148,101,120,.07)}.rpgVillageAction:active{transform:translateY(2px);background:#f9edf3}.rpgVillageAction strong{display:block;font-size:22px;margin-bottom:4px}.rpgVillageAction.wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.rpgStatusParty{display:grid;gap:10px}.rpgStatusSheet{padding:13px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ead7df}.rpgStatusSheetHead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:9px;font-weight:1000;color:#644e59}.rpgStatusSheetHead span:first-child{font-size:15px}.rpgStatusRaw{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:5px}.rpgStatusRaw div,.rpgStatusDerived div{padding:7px 3px;border-radius:11px;background:#faf1f5;text-align:center}.rpgStatusRaw b,.rpgStatusDerived b{display:block;font-size:7px;color:#9b7c8a}.rpgStatusRaw strong,.rpgStatusDerived strong{font-size:10px;color:#5f4955}.rpgStatInvest{position:relative;padding-bottom:27px!important}.rpgStatPlus{position:absolute;left:5px;right:5px;bottom:5px;height:18px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#e9bfd0;color:#5f4050;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;line-height:18px}.rpgStatPlus:disabled{background:#eee6ea;color:#baa9b1}.rpgSkillPanel{margin-top:9px;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px .rpgNpcTalkCard{margin-top:16px;padding:20px 18px;border-radius:24px;background:#fff9fc;border:1px solid #ead1dc;text-align:center;cursor:pointer}.rpgNpcFace{font-size:54px}.rpgNpcName{font-size:13px;font-weight:1000;color:#674f5c;margin:8px 0}.rpgNpcSpeech{padding:14px;border-radius:18px;background:#f8edf3;color:#705965;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.6}.rpgNpcTap{margin-top:10px;color:#9b7d8b;font-size:8px;font-weight:900}
.rpgTravelTicker{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;margin:9px 0;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:17px;background:#fff8fb;border:1px solid #e8d4dd;color:#806574;font-size:9px;font-weight:1000}.rpgTravelDots{display:flex;gap:5px}.rpgTravelDots i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#e4d6dd;border:1px solid #d2bec8}.rpgTravelDots i.on{background:#d58eaa;border-color:#c87597}

.rpgRewardCard{max-width:390px}.rpgRewardIcon{font-size:46px;text-align:center}.rpgRewardTitle{text-align:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:1000;color:#674f5c;margin:4px 0 12px}.rpgRewardLoot{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px}.rpgRewardLoot div{padding:10px 5px;border-radius:14px;background:#fbf1f5;text-align:center}.rpgRewardLoot b{display:block;font-size:8px;color:#987a88}.rpgRewardLoot strong{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:14px;color:#624b58}.rpgLevelSheet{display:none;margin-top:10px}.rpgLevelSheet.show{display:block}.rpgLevelWho{text-align:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:1000;color:#624b58;margin-bottom:8px}.rpgLevelStats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:5px}.rpgLevelStats div{padding:9px 2px;border-radius:12px;background:#f6edf6;text-align:center}.rpgLevelStats b{display:block;font-size:7px;color:#967987}.rpgLevelStats strong{font-size:13px;color:#5f4a55}.rpgRewardNote{margin-top:8px;font-size:8px;color:#957987;text-align:center;font-weight:800;line-height:1.45}
@media(max-width:390px){.rpgVillageGrid{gap:7px}.rpgVillageAction{min-height:70px;font-size:10px}.rpgVillageAction strong{font-size:19px}#rpgFieldPage .content{width:calc(100% - 24px)}.rpgRewardLoot{gap:5px}.rpgLevelStats{gap:4px}}

<body>
<div id="app">
  <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

  <!-- v4.8.9 temporary diagnostics -->
  <button class="diagFloatBtn" id="diagFloatBtn" type="button" aria-label="자가진단 로그">🩺</button>
  <div class="diagOverlay" id="diagOverlay" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="diagCard" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="diagTitle">
      <div class="diagTitleRow">
        <div class="diagTitle" id="diagTitle">🩺 후냥 자가진단</div>
        <button class="diagClose" id="diagCloseBtn" type="button" aria-label="닫기">×</button>
      </div>
      <div class="diagSub">앱 동작을 자동 기록 중이냥. 문제가 생기면 이 로그를 저장하거나 복사해서 확인하면 된다냥 🐾</div>
      <div class="diagStatus">
        <span class="diagChip ok">● 기록 중</span>
        <span class="diagChip">v4.8.26</span>
        <span class="diagChip" id="diagSessionChip">session</span>
      </div>
      <textarea class="diagLogBox" id="diagLogBox" readonly spellcheck="false"></textarea>
      <div class="diagBtns">
        <button class="diagBtn primaryDiag" id="diagSaveBtn" type="button">로그 파일 저장</button>
        <button class="diagBtn" id="diagCopyBtn" type="button">로그 복사</button>
        <button class="diagBtn" id="diagRefreshBtn" type="button">새로고침</button>
        <button class="diagBtn dangerDiag" id="diagClearBtn" type="button">로그 초기화</button>
      </div>
      <div class="diagFoot">임시 개발용 기능이야. 정식 출시판에서는 진단 버튼과 상세 로그를 제거할 예정.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Splash -->
  <section class="page active noBottom" id="splashPage">
    <button class="mobileSettingsBtn" id="mobileSettingsBtn" type="button" aria-label="설정">⚙</button>
    <div class="safeTop"></div>
    <div class="splashContent">
      <div class="splashMascot">
        <div class="mascotSpeech" id="mascotSpeech" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          <span class="speechText" id="speechText"></span>
          <span class="speechPaw" aria-hidden="true">🐾</span>
        </div>
        <img src="data:image/png;base64,
